decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, Design & Access Statement, 01P, 02P, 03P, 04P and 05P Received: 09 May 2012 
06B, 07B, 08B, 09B, 10B and 13B Received: 22 June 2012)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope
description: Conversion of existing loft into habitable space and installation of roof lights into existing roof slope
